sources.address_conversion: Stable-Retro Genesis source addresses in the 24-bit 0xFF0000-0xFFFFFF work-RAM range are represented as 64 KiB core_ram offsets by subtracting 0xFF0000. The equivalent sign-extended 68000 range is 0xFFFF0000-0xFFFFFFFF. The EDAS Mega Drive reader convention uses byte_order swap16 and big endian.
